items.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill two, including police chief
items.summary: Israeli drone strikes killed at least 2 people and wounded several others in Gaza on Thursday.

items.title: Huge explosion rocks Italian munitions factory south of Rome
items.summary: A powerful explosion tore through a munitions faction south of the Italian capital Rome on Thursday.

items.title: Yemen at Risk of Entering Wider Middle East Conflict, UN Special Envoy Warns Security Council, as Several Members Condemn Escalating Houthi Attacks
items.summary: The conflict expanding across the Middle East has now arrived on Yemen’s shores, the senior United Nations official in the country told the Security Council today, warning that attacks by Houthi militants on critical waterways are imperiling global trade and threatening to pull Yemen into the “vortex” of the wider war.

items.title: Daily Press Briefing by the Office of the Spokesperson for the Secretary-General
items.summary: UN Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher has allocated $5 million from the UN Central Emergency Response Fund to support the humanitarian response in Colombia following the devastating earthquake there. The UN is also deploying teams to assess needs in most impacted areas, in coordination with local authorities.

items.title: Is Russia’s economy cracking despite the Iran war windfall?
items.summary: A widening deficit and Ukrainian strikes are testing Russia's economy, even as war in the Middle East lifts oil revenue.
